narr: A slow moving thunderstorm produced up to golf ball size hail and flooding in the town of Sterling. A weaker storm to the east produced hail up to 1 inch in the Haxtun area.
ev: Reports of flooded roads with water 2 to 3 feet deep in some areas. Hail clogged the city's storm drains. The basements of the Logan County Courthouse and the courthouse annex flooded.
lsr: Reports of flooded roads with water 2 to 3 feet deep in some areas.
Report from mPING: Street/road flooding; Street/road closed; Vehicles stranded.
